outcome: Use Case, BDD, Example Mapping, Event Storming, DDD, API Design, ADR, and Threat Modeling are selectable method packs
acceptance: the catalog lists user-story plus use-case, bdd, example-mapping, event-storming, ddd, api-design, adr, and threat-modeling
a new project has user-story enabled and the extra packs disabled until selected
enabling a method pack lets a planner run produce that method's output fields
a WorkItem records the method pack that produced it
missing method skills are reported as skill gaps and block the planner run
disabling a pack prevents new planner runs with that method
inScope: built-in design method pack catalog beyond User Story
planner method-specific skills, output fields, and skill-gap reporting
assumptions: User Story is already the default method baseline
prioritization packs stay in the next D row
